map_resources.notes: All resources available for Northwatch Wardens encounters. Check these before generating AI maps. Season 1 is predominantly winter/cold — prioritise snow tablecloth, DT5/DU3 cave sets, and Reincarnated Dungeon/Wilderness tiles.

tablecloth.name: Snow Field Tablecloth
tablecloth.description: Large snow-covered open field. Ideal base layer for any winter outdoor encounter — Welton road ambush, icefield travel, Palebank Village exterior.

tablecloth.name: Snow Field with River Tablecloth
tablecloth.description: Snow-covered terrain with a river running through it. Good for riverside ambushes, frozen crossing encounters, or any winter wetland scene.

tactical_maps_reincarnated.notes: Physical poster maps (double-sided). Mix-and-match for encounters. These are the physical versions of the Reincarnated PDFs.

gloomhaven_base.notes: Base Gloomhaven (1st Ed). Hex-grid, 1-inch hexes, modular. 60 unique map tiles across 14 shape configs. 4 terrain art styles: MS (Man Made Stone — dungeon), NS (Natural Stone — cave), W (Wood — building), DG (Dirt & Grass — outdoor). Source: Gloomhaven_Tiles_Manifest_and_Graphic_Study.xlsx
gloomhaven_base.grid_type: hex (1-inch hexes) — does not align with D&D square grid; use as visual reference or freeform layout

terrain_types.MS: Man Made Stone — cut stone dungeon/fortress aesthetic. Best for Salsvault, Temple of Dragonknights.
terrain_types.NS: Natural Stone — rough cave/cavern aesthetic. Best for Croaker Cave, icefield encounters.
terrain_types.W: Wood — timber building interiors. Best for Waystone Inn, Jolly Dwarf Tavern.
terrain_types.DG: Dirt & Grass — outdoor ground. Best for Welton, Palebank Village exterior.

tile_catalog.notes: Config = hex row pattern (e.g. '5-4' = two rows of 5 and 4 hexes). Qty = copies in base game box.

overlay_tile_totals.notes: Approximate totals across all sheets for planning purposes
overlay_tile_totals.doors: ~50 — wall door pieces, key for connecting rooms

northwatch_uses.croaker-cave: Sheets 01-06 for cave passages; DU3/DT5 overlay tiles for cave texture; doors for the cave entry and Sett's hideout divider
northwatch_uses.salsvault: Sheets 07-10 for larger rooms; sheets 11-13 overlay tiles for obstacles and hazardous terrain; sheet 18 corridors for facility passageways
northwatch_uses.temple-of-dragonknights: Sheets 07-09 for grand halls; obstacle tiles for altar and pillar dressing; door tiles for chamber entrances
northwatch_uses.any-dungeon: Mix sheets 01-06 (corridors/small rooms) with 07-10 (large rooms) and 11-18 overlay tiles for full encounter dressing

digital_maps.notes: All maps exist in both gridded (.jpg) and gridless ( (gridless).jpg ) versions. All appear to be from a commercial VTT battlemap bundle.

maps.description: Walled garden or cultivated outdoor space with a stone shrine/monument, dirt paths, flower beds, surrounding dense tree line. Summery/temperate.
Open forest clearing with wildflowers (purple, red, blue), a single large boulder at center, forest canopy surrounding. Summery green.
Forested area with a dirt road or path cutting diagonally through dense forest. Lush temperate forest, large tree canopy.
Warm-lit multi-room building interior: main common room with fireplace, side rooms including what appears to be a bedroom and storage, wooden plank floors, outdoor overhang/porch visible.
Large open grassy meadow bordered by dense forest on both sides. Ancient stone ruin/well at center. Temperate, summery coloring.
Outdoor stone-paved plaza with ruined columns, raised central platform, scattered rubble and overgrown vegetation. Worn stone aesthetic, good for temple exterior or ancient site.
Dark stone dungeon with multiple connected rooms and corridors, torchlight at intervals. L-shaped layout with staircase visible. Classic dungeon stone.

tile_pdfs.notes: D&D 4e-era WotC Dungeon Tiles product line plus Reincarnated editions. Print and cut for physical use, or use digitally in VTT. Square grid, 1 inch = 1 square.

sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Set 1
sets.aesthetic: Warm tan-beige flagstone, clean painted style, classic dungeon torchlight warmth

sets.name: Hidden Crypts (Set 3)
sets.aesthetic: Cool blue-grey weathered stone, dim crypts feel, blood-red graffiti accent, muted cold palette

sets.filename: DT4 Ruins of the Wild_ Dungeon Tiles.pdf
sets.name: DT4: Ruins of the Wild
sets.aesthetic: Naturalistic warm greens and earthy browns, bright daylight, loose organic painted style
tile_types: scatter tokens (pools, logs, boulders, stone ring)

sets.filename: DT5 Dungeon Tiles_ Lost Caverns of the Underdark.pdf
sets.name: DT5: Lost Caverns of the Underdark
sets.aesthetic: Dark desaturated grey-green cave rock, photorealistic texture, deep blacks, oppressive atmosphere
tile_types: irregular cave corridors wide and narrow

sets.name: DT6: Dire Tombs
sets.aesthetic: Warm amber-yellow sandstone, ancient Egyptian/desert tomb feel, ochre and gold palette, torchlit warmth

sets.filename: DT7 Dungeon Tiles_ Fane of the Forgotten Gods.pdf
sets.name: DT7: Fane of the Forgotten Gods
sets.aesthetic: Cool grey-green aged temple masonry, moss, classical columns and arches, magical blue glow accents, outdoor sections with grass surroundings

sets.filename: DT99  WITCHLIGHT FENS, THE - DUNGEON TILES.pdf
sets.name: DT99: Witchlight Fens
sets.aesthetic: Muted blue-grey swamp water, grey-green moss and algae, dark overcast lighting, organic murky palette

sets.filename: DU3 Dungeon Tiles_ Caves of Carnage.pdf
sets.name: DU3: Caves of Carnage
sets.aesthetic: Very dark and gloomy grey-green cave rock, glowing green acid/slime pools, heavily shadowed, claustrophobic and dangerous

sets.name: DU4: Arcane Towers
sets.aesthetic: Cool grey-beige stone masonry, smooth flagstone, scholarly and refined, modest wall-sconce lighting, warm accents on furnishings

sets.name: DU5: Sinister Woods
sets.aesthetic: Lush vivid green forest, bright daylight filtering through canopy, rich saturated greens, dense and enclosed

sets.name: DU6: Shadowghast Manor
sets.aesthetic: Cool grey-green stonework, dim amber torch glow, Gothic and funerary, dark oppressive masonry, ornate but decayed tile patterns
sets.notes: Identical tile content to Shadowghast Manor (alt) — owning both gives duplicate tiles useful for larger layouts.

sets.name: Shadowghast Manor (alternate edition)
sets.notes: Alternate retail packaging of DU6 — same tiles. Duplicate set useful for constructing larger cemetery or crypt layouts without cutting.

sets.filename: Dungeon Tiles Master Set - The Dungeon_ An Essential.pdf
sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Master Set — The Dungeon
sets.aesthetic: Desaturated grey-green dungeon stone, gritty painted style, dim ambient light, metal fixtures and rust marks, realistic sober tone

sets.filename: Dungeon Tiles Master Set - the Wilderness An Essential.pdf
sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Master Set — Wilderness
sets.aesthetic: Rich natural green fields and blue water, full daylight painterly style, bright and colourful, highly detailed grass texture

sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Reincarnated — Dungeon
sets.aesthetic: Cool blue-grey stone, clean flagstone, higher contrast than originals, magical glowing effects, moonlight-blue ambient tone
tile_types: plain stone floor rooms multiple sizes

sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Reincarnated — Wilderness
sets.aesthetic: Highly varied — green forest, blue water, ochre desert, dark underground in same set; painterly naturalistic style
sets.notes: Most diverse single set — covers 6 terrain types: grassland, forest, swamp, desert, water, underground river.

sets.name: Dungeon Tiles Reincarnated — City
sets.aesthetic: Aged grey-brown cobblestone streets with moss and puddles; vivid green-slimed sewers; grey-blue harbour water; gritty urban style with lantern warm-light accents
sets.notes: Only dedicated urban set in the library. Sewer section has full modular connectivity.
